changeSet.author: herbert

preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from clinlims.site_information where name = 'requesterRequired';

changeSet.comment: Add requesterRequired configuration to site_information (Sample Entry Config). When true, Search Requester and Requester First/Last Name are required on Order Entry; when false (default), all three are optional.

column.name: description
column.value: If true, Search Requester and Requester First/Last Name are required on Order Entry. Default false makes them optional.
